name: Sabey Data Centers Ashburn - Building C

source.basis: Operator facility page; structured facts only, no operator prose reproduced.

reading.body:
Sabey Data Centers Ashburn Building C publishes 54 MW of IT capacity, ranking sixth among Virginia facilities with disclosed power figures on this site.

Building C represents roughly 4 percent of the 1,326 MW total published across 19 Virginia facilities tracked here. However, Virginia's full dataset contains 326 mapped facilities, most of which publish no capacity figure. The actual megawatt share this single building holds in the state remains unknown. This gap matters because published figures may cluster in specific facility types or operators, skewing estimates of total available power for AI workloads.

The 54 MW ceiling translates to between 1,350 and 5,400 racks depending on power density per cabinet. At 40 kW per rack, a common density for GPU training servers, the space supports roughly 1,350 racks. At 10 kW per rack, a conservative colocation density, it supports roughly 5,400 racks. The operator publishes no rack count, cooling architecture, or per-cabinet power density. Which assumption applies cannot be determined from available data, making it impossible to assess what fraction of this power can actually serve high-density AI training.

The facility holds six compliance certifications covering financial controls, security audits, payment processing, health data, and information security standards. These qualifications enable the building to host regulated enterprise and government workloads alongside commercial AI work. The operator does not publish current tenancy, so which use cases actually occupy the space is unknown.
